description: Full detail for one symbol: signature, doc comment, location, container — and optionally its source. Identify the symbol by id (from search_symbols/get_file_outline), by file+line position, or by exact name.

cursor.description: continuation token from a truncated response; repeat the same arguments with it

include_source.description: append the symbol source; a long body pages via cursor instead of being cut at 60 lines

max_tokens.description: soft cap on response size in estimated tokens; truncated output says how to get the rest

name.description: exact name; lists all matches if ambiguous

path.description: with line: look up the innermost symbol at that position

name: get_symbol_info
title: Symbol info
